Python 3.11 venv with fastapi/sqlalchemy/psycopg2/pgvector/httpx/pytest etc installed once, no per-worktree pip installs — ran pytest with PYTHONPATH=<worktree> and cwd=<worktree> so mast/api packages resolve straight from source. Root-level tests/*.py hardcode POSTGRES_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://localhost/mast_vc and the user's existing local Postgres container already has a populated mast_vc schema — tests connect directly and self-clean via DELETE-in-finally blocks keyed to unique per-test source names, no pollution observed across 6 DB-backed candidates. tests/unit/* never touch a DB (mocked). For every candidate the PR's fix is inseparable from its test additions, so the merge-commit's version of the changed test file(s) was overlaid onto the base worktree before running red (SWE-bench-style FAIL_TO_PASS reproduction).
